# The Startup Blog — llms.txt
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

> The Startup Blog covers startups, AI tools, and tech industry news for founders and builders.
> Content is written in English, targeting a global audience of entrepreneurs, developers, and tech professionals.

## About

The Startup Blog is a content resource covering the startup ecosystem, emerging AI tools, and tech industry trends. It is run by the team behind StartupOnX, a startup directory platform.

## Content Categories

### Startups
Articles on startup validation, launch strategy, fundraising, and go-to-market approaches for early-stage founders.

### AI Tools
Reviews and comparisons of AI tools relevant to startups and developers — coding assistants, productivity tools, and AI infrastructure.

### Tech News
Analysis of tech industry trends, funding landscape shifts, and developments relevant to founders and builders.

## Key Articles

- How to Validate a Startup Idea Before Building It: https://boldblog.in/startups/how-to-validate-startup-idea.html
- Why Startup Directories Still Matter in 2026: https://boldblog.in/startups/why-startup-directories-matter-2026.html
- Best AI Tools for Startups in 2026: https://boldblog.in/ai-tools/best-ai-tools-for-startups-2026.html
- AI Coding Assistants Compared 2026: https://boldblog.in/ai-tools/ai-coding-assistants-compared-2026.html
- The State of AI Startup Funding in 2026: https://boldblog.in/tech-news/ai-startup-funding-2026.html

## Target Audience
- Early-stage startup founders
